comment: amd-rig SDR HITL bench catalog (read by hitl-reserved --catalog on the amd64 //pi/hitl:hitl_sdr variant). Unlike the fleet-identical Pi catalog.json, this host offers ONE composite reservable unit: an ESP32-C6 wired next to a HackRF One, handed out together as a single atomic reservation for reverse-engineering the ESP32's lower-layer WiFi/BT stacks. No auto-discovery (discovery yields single-board units, not composites) and no FX2 analyzer / provisioning-AP (see nix/hitl-sdr.nix). host/workspace + the unit sshd port range are passed as flags by nix/hitl-sdr.nix, not baked here.

components.comment: The ESP32-C6 DUT, addressed by its built-in USB-JTAG by-id symlink (stable across re-enumeration) and pinned to /dev/ttyACM0 inside the reservation env so the toolbox (hitl-flash/monitor, default /dev/ttyACM0) works unchanged. HITL_ADAPTER_SERIAL selects this board's USB-JTAG for openocd/gdb.
components.name: c6-0

components.comment: The HackRF One. A raw-USB SDR with no serial tty, so it isn't isolated by the tty→USB-port path; the reservation container runs privileged (single-unit bench) and sees the whole /dev/bus/usb, which includes the HackRF at 1d50:6089. hackrf_info + GNU Radio/gr-osmosdr in the env drive it.
components.name: sdr-0

units.comment: The composite unit: C6 + HackRF reserved together as one atomic unit for lower-layer RE. Its capabilities are the union of both components (flash/monitor/jtag/gdb + sdr/rx/tx/wideband). Target it with `hitl reserve --type esp32c6+hackrf` or `--unit c6-sdr`. pin_only: this C6 is SDR-hardwired (wired to the HackRF, no antenna) and there's only one, so it must NOT absorb ordinary caps-only work — e.g. the netstack/vendor tests that reserve 'any DUT with flash+improv+wss-app' would otherwise match it and steal the SDR bench. pin_only makes it reachable ONLY by an explicit target (its unit name or the esp32c6+hackrf type, both of which the SDR reservations use); a bare caps-only/any request skips it. See engine eligible(): by-name and by-type opt past pin-only, caps-only gets !PinOnly.
units.name: c6-sdr
